lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 12 -- Describing People and Their Work

listenings.text: Good morning. Here is a short note about the work of this month. Marina wrote the report, and she sent it to us last week. I shared it with the group yesterday. Peter invited the German team to our call, and they answered him this morning. He will introduce them to us on Monday. If you have any question about the platform, write to Joice. She can help you. And please, answer me before Friday, because I need your names for the November list. Thank you.

Hi, this is a short message for the group. Somebody asked me a very good question: who do we contact when the platform does not work? The answer is simple. First, write to your coordinator, and he sends it to the technical team for you. Do not write to them directly, because they answer only the coordinators. If it is urgent, call me. My number is in the group document. Thank you very much.

extra_audio.text: Joice reads the email about the work of the month. She sees that Marina sent the report to the group. She writes to Marina and thanks her. She asks Peter to introduce the German team to her. She sends her answer to the coordinator before Friday.

lesson.grammar_point: object pronouns (me, him, her, it, us, them)

reading.rtitle: Meteoro Program -- Who Does What This Month
paras: Dear all, here is a short note about the work of this month. Please read it and answer me before Friday.
Marina wrote the report about small schools. She sent it to us last week, and she asked me to share it with the group. I sent it to everybody yesterday.
Peter organizes the meeting with the German team. He invited them to our call, and they answered him this morning. He will introduce them to us on Monday.
Joice evaluates the new platform. If you have any question about it, write to her. She can help you, and she can also contact the technical team for us.
